notes: Release 2.17.0 — operational layer; again app-logic only, so the knowledge pack stays at 2.10.0 and no practitioner sign-off was required. (1) The classical day-division triad is complete: Yamaganda and Gulika Kaal now sit beside Rahu Kaal, all three cut from the same sunrise solve (daylight / 8, one fixed part per weekday), non-overlapping, with the weekday slot tables pinned against the canonical chart. (2) Night Choghadiya — the engine always computed sixteen slots but the report printed only the eight daytime ones; all sixteen now render. (3) The Panchang module states its own cordon in the client's view, not just in markup: a 'timing and horizon readout only' card disclaiming any effect on Lo Shu void remedies, crystals, deity selection or Vastu zones, plus a tier-honesty badge naming the horizon it was cast for and noting that no birth time is required. (4) A 16-zone degree-precise Vastu compass (section 16A): an optional 0-360 bearing for the main entrance, kitchen burner, master bed and water source resolves to a 22.5-degree zone AND to the classical 45-degree sector computed from the same bearing — so an N-N-E reading at 20 degrees is governed by the North and the same zone at 30 degrees by the North-East. Two honesty flags no surveyed competitor offers: a reading within 2 degrees of a zone edge is called unreliable instead of being reported to false precision, and a reading within 2 degrees of a sector boundary warns that ordinary compass error would change the governing direction. Any dosh reuses the shipped eight-direction remedy verbatim; no sixteenth remedy doctrine was invented, which is why the content gate was not triggered. (5) Mobile internal digit flow: the number is now read as a sequence as well as a total — adjacent pairs classified by the same one-way Moolank Maitri relation the rest of the report uses, pairs containing 0 reported as lordless rather than forced into a relation, absent and over-weighted digits named, and the longest hostility-free stretch counted. Deliberately no percentage score: smoke asserts the report emits no 'N% lucky' anywhere. Release 2.16.0 — competitive-parity release; no remedy, dosha, deity, mantra, crystal, charity, fasting or Vastu prescription field changed, so the knowledge pack stays at 2.10.0 and no practitioner sign-off was required. App-logic only, five new reading surfaces, each structurally forbidden from carrying a remedy obligation (smoke pins that every one of them contains zero data-remedy-authority nodes): (1) Name Architecture — the Chaldean name is decomposed into Soul Urge (vowels), Personality (consonants) and Expression, with a per-letter value strip, Cornerstone / Capstone / First Vowel, and the existing spelling-correction candidates re-stated as architecture rather than a second, parallel set; (2) Premises Numerology — an optional house / flat / plot / office / shop / desk / account number read in two layers, the door digits alone and the full token with its block letter, graded against the Driver and Conductor, answered with nameplate tuning rather than advice to move; (3) Personal Cycles — Personal Year / Month / Day on the same calendar-year convention Section 13 already uses, a graded month calendar, and a 90-day favourable-date finder covering exactly the five life events the Dasha engine already defines, with the full scoring trail on every date; (4) Panchang depth — the Muhurtha section now computes all five limbs (tithi with paksha and Rikta flag, nakshatra with pada and lord, yoga, karana with the Vishti/Bhadra flag, vara) each with its end time, plus the eight daytime Choghadiya and Abhijit Muhurta with its Wednesday exclusion, all from the shipped Meeus ephemeris rather than a tabulated almanac; (5) an optional, collapsed Western (Pythagorean) cross-reference — Life Path, Expression, Soul Urge, Personality, Maturity, Balance, Rational Thought, Karmic Lessons, Hidden Passion, Subconscious Self and the Decoz Planes of Expression — cordoned exactly like the Feng Shui / Kua module, stating where it agrees with the Vedic reading and where it does not. Also fixed a shipping defect: muhurtha.js was loaded by index.html but absent from both the static build manifest and the service-worker precache list, so the production bundle 404'd on it and an installed PWA lost the whole Muhurtha section offline. The build now throws if index.html references any script it does not ship, and the smoke suite loads the same script list the page does. Practitioner audit corrections (pack 2.10.0, app 2.15.0): the planetary friendship matrix now follows the classical one-way Moolank Maitri chart — e.g. the Sun (1) is friendly to Venus (6) and Mars (9), not to the Moon (2) or Jupiter (3) — with the documented shadow stance toward Rahu (4) / Ketu (7) preserved per row and both shadow rows unchanged; 22 of the 72 one-way entries were reclassified. The North Vastu zone now carries its classical Water element (the Kubera / wealth-flow element) instead of Earth, and the Mercury (5) Dasha Vastu zone is the North — the Kubera sector of the report's own Vedic compass — instead of the Brahmasthan, with its zone remedy re-pointed to the North sector (EN/HI/GU). Every other table (Chaldean, grid engines, Vimshottari order/durations, Kua, Lo Shu, pinnacles, karmic debts, beej mantras, rudraksha, gems, Ashta Dikpalaka compass, Ank Jyotish Dasha arithmetic) was re-verified against classical sources and is unchanged. Print-dossier polish (app 2.14.1): badge pills now grow around wrapped labels and the Section 6 Name Tuning / Section 14 90-day Pratyantar cells stack title and description as separate blocks on defined 1.35 leading, so a wrapped "Window 1 — Everyday / Public" or "Friction with AD" badge can no longer paint its second line over the description below it in the printed PDF; the Sunday Micro-Routine row carries complete dressing guidance ("Wear: Gold, saffron, or warm yellow"). Dual-name intake (app 2.14.0): the single "Full Name" field becomes two — Everyday / Professional Name (business card, email signature, bank card, LinkedIn; it drives the primary Name Number, the Lo Shu Name grid and the hero) and an optional Full Legal Name (Aadhaar / PAN spelling) scored beside it as the Document / Legal Total. The legal middle name / patronymic now feeds an Authentic Middle Initial strategy (Kishorbhai → K, Ravindra → R) that is offered ahead of every spelling alteration at 5/5, arbitrary A–Z initials are suppressed whenever the real family letter is known, a patronymic already carried in full is compressed rather than duplicated, and every suggestion states its window — Window 1 Everyday / Public (business cards, profiles, letterheads; no paperwork) or Window 2 Formal / Document (passport, KYC, Aadhaar, incorporation; the patronymic is held byte-for-byte and only the first name is tuned). A legal total landing on a karmic number (13/14/16/19) is scanned as its own source, and the practitioner cockpit prints the statutory total beside the everyday one. Hybrid release: classic Lo Shu Foundation (Birth, Name and Combined grids) as the primary remedy blueprint, Vedic Ank Kundali retained as a birth-only Planetary Strength Indicator, the independent proportional Ank Jyotish Dasha / active Vastu timeline, the additive Classical Vimshottari layer anchored on the natal Moon nakshatra, a client-selected Scaled Sadhana practice depth (Beginner 11x / Practitioner-Sadhak 27x / Classical 108x) plus an upfront Ethical & Health Notice inside the Northstar Summary, and a complete partner-Moon stack — Chandra-bala (Rashi axis), Astro-Identity positions, partner Vimshottari and Nakshatra-level Tara Bala. New in app 2.13.0 (architecture & UX audit): event-window grid-authority tagging (Vedic vs Lo Shu, with divergence disclosure), Kua cordoned into an optional Feng Shui module beside a classical Ashta Dikpalaka Vastu card, Ank Jyotish as the default primary Dasha engine with the secondary engine cordoned behind an Advanced Astrological Cross-Reference appendix, goal aggregation into one Combined Strategic Focus section, technical-leak sanitisation (JSON payload / Meeus strings / h0 hidden from the client view), progressive-disclosure Layer-1 summary with a 7-Day Micro-Routine table and DO / DO-NOT cards, Client vs Practitioner report bundling, a 1–5 name-correction practicality rating with middle-initial options, and automated conflict muting for solar overload. Pack stays 2.9.0 (app logic only). Previous 2.12.0: partner birth time & place intake, mutual Rashi axis, partner Vimshottari, Tara Bala. Formatting & client-agency polish (app 2.13.1): the 7-Day Micro-Routine action cells now print labelled Wear / Action / Donate lines instead of concatenated prose (and never double a "Donate" prefix), the solar-overload mute states plainly that a brief 30-second sunrise arghya remains (only extended sun rituals, midday Solar Activation and Surya Bhedana are skipped), the 90-day Pratyantar Vastu micro-action prints clause-per-line with one complete sentence per bullet, a client-text hygiene pass removes line-wrap artefacts such as a dangling hyphen before punctuation, and Section 6 now presents BOTH name strategies in one table — Strategy column with middle initials first (legal/banking clean, rating 5), pronunciation-preserving spelling alterations underneath (low-contrast double such as "Sambhhvani" 4, ending-shifting double 3, same-sound swap, Suniel-style ending vowel) — each row carrying its own star rating and group hint.
